name: orca-script-workbench
description: 虎鲸｜剧本出海工作站 Web shell

scripts.dev: SCRIPT_SYNC_LOCAL_MODE=1 concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,blue "cd apps/web && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-dev next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000" "cd apps/api && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
scripts.dev:watch: SCRIPT_SYNC_LOCAL_MODE=1 concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,blue "cd apps/web && NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-dev next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000" "cd apps/api && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000"
scripts.dev:web: cd apps/web && SCRIPT_SYNC_LOCAL_MODE=1 NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-dev next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,blue "npm run start:web" "npm run start:api"
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api && npm run check:agent
